depth.strategy: Flat tonal fields and imagery; continuous native image reader with sticky header; no shadows.

extraction.authority: Implemented source code and the repeatedly authorised final refinements; incumbent world, token names and qualitative language are preserved.
extraction.tonalRamps: Synthesized preview-only OKLCH ramps: constant source hue and chroma, lightness from 15% to 95%; not application primitives.

componentPreviewImage.encoding: Embedded data URI; actual curated project derivative.

extraction.notCanonized: The established world is retained. Retired compact-gallery and visible-tour components are not inherited; unrelated unused CSS and superseded surface-brief wording are outside this documentation write boundary.
extraction.componentPreviewGeometry: Component-specific sizing reproduces the built image/reader dimensions without a universal reset. Small embedded samples retain the app’s source-width caps and contained proportions.

componentPreviewPlanImage.encoding: Embedded 480px WebP preview; actual anonymised public plan derivative.

planEvidence.sources: 18 supplied PDF first pages and two images; 20 public previews in six collections.
planEvidence.privacy: Identifying title blocks cropped; other client/email/phone text masked in pixels. Source originals remain outside the public export.
planEvidence.publicLinks: Images only, including project sketches; no plan/sketch PDF downloads or public copies.

localeEvidence.languageState: Menu-toggle, hashchange and popstate synchronise destinations before ordinary or new-tab navigation; click also preserves search/hash.
localeEvidence.seo: Khushali Jain in Heilbronn, Germany; planned https://iamkhushali.com, configured by SITE_URL. Canonical, en/de-DE/x-default alternatives, JSON-LD, sitemap and robots describe the person/portfolio; no invented separate business brand.

contentEvidence.voice: Simple, human and professional English/German; sketching/sketches in English.
contentEvidence.resume: One-page German CV at /downloads/khushali-jain-resume.pdf, linked from About and eligible footer surfaces; no contact-page or contact-footer résumé link.

componentPreviewPanoramaImage.encoding: Embedded 480px still-image derivative; 360° source remains self-hosted separately.

interactionEvidence.scope: Final source and supplied 47 passing board/panorama checks; no design interview or unrelated aesthetic substitution.

typographyOverrides.purpose: Supplementary language suffix, not body copy.

carousel.invariant: Slide images are absolute; frame, caption slots, controls and thumbnail strip do not shift between projects.
carousel.imageControls: 44px square pale arrow buttons at image edges, 18px inset, vertically centred.
carousel.playback: Automatic six-second advance; paused for hover/focus/hidden/offscreen/reduced motion, with P toggle; no visible tour toolbar.

gallery.layout: Horizontal wrapping flex rows; all pictures shown by default; 22px wide gaps.
gallery.phoneLayout: Two pictures per row; 18px row and 14px column gaps.
gallery.pairedSets: Two-picture filtered sets remain side by side at every size.
gallery.sourceCaps: Board/reader max-width equals image.width; original proportions remain intact.
gallery.reader: Native scrollable dialog, min(1400px, 100vw - 40px); 100dvh - 40px height; sticky header.
gallery.navigation: Actual room filters, native continuous scrolling, adjacent-image arrow keys, fragment tracking and opener focus restoration.

index.expansion: Eight projects or twelve spaces per explicit request.

plans.disclosure: Native exclusive details name group; starts closed.

header.wide: Wordmark, four links and compact globe/code menu in one row.
header.phone: Grid: wordmark/menu in row one; all four links in row two.
header.languageTarget: 44px minimum height; 13px visible EN/DE code; unbordered trigger.

panorama.lifecycle: Explicit activation; self-hosted assets load on demand; viewer destroyed when disabled or offscreen; still image remains available.

sourceSpread.wide: Two images in equal columns, 20px gap, native-width caps.
sourceSpread.phone: First image only; second spread image hidden.
sourceSpread.examples: Collection33: paired hero at 640px; collection26: single 1136px first view, capped in board and reader.

projectPalette.meaning: Image-derived content colours, not global brand primitives or installed-material specifications.
projectPalette.evidence: Each swatch links to its imageId in the same project gallery.

media.policy: Native user-controlled films retain source AAC audio; no autoplay; preload none. Carousel rotation uses still project images.

narrative.northStar: Editorial photo essay and room atlas
narrative.overview:
The interiors are the visual material. An expressive serif supplies an authored voice; a clear sans-serif carries the practical information around it. The interface is quiet and editorial, with image scale and alignment creating the hierarchy. View boards, focused indexes and disclosures keep the work easy to compare. Opening a picture leads into a continuous image reader, so the project remains one coherent sequence.

Sage-white and green ink provide a stable ground. Subdued stone, blue-grey and sage fields extend colours found in the work, while rectangular image windows retain room context. Depth comes from these tonal fields and the photographs and visualisations themselves. Borders mark controls and useful separations rather than enclosing every piece of content. Motion follows an architectural opening: a shutter, lateral picture movement and a caption reveal preserve continuity within a stable frame.
keyCharacteristics: Actual project imagery integrated with adjacent colour fields.
Gloock display headings paired with Hanken Grotesk copy and controls.
Stable carousel windows, responsive view boards and precise caption alignment.
Flat rectangular surfaces, sparse rules and image-derived palette samples.
Sentence-case labels, visible keyboard focus and bounded architectural motion.

rules.name: The Image Field Rule
rules.body: Select the subdued project field from the imagery and keep the text and control palette consistent across it.

rules.name: The Boundary Rule
rules.body: Pale editorial rules separate content; darker control boundaries identify facet menus, the open language menu, panorama zoom controls and carousel image-navigation buttons.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Gloock for major statements and Hanken Grotesk for project information, supporting headings and controls. Keep labels in ordinary sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Let imagery and tonal fields establish depth; keep project entries and controls free of card shadows.

dos: **Do** use actual project imagery and carry its subdued field into adjacent composition.
**Do** preserve room context, mixed image proportions and aligned factual captions.
**Do** keep the serif/sans roles and stable green text/control palette across project fields.
**Do** retain visible focus, native labels, state attributes and comfortable touch targets.
**Do** preserve two-picture comparisons on phones and keep the image reader naturally scrollable.
**Do** keep carousel geometry stable and preserve source proportions in view boards and readers.
**Do** keep motion bounded, automatic carousel playback pausable and all content available without movement.
**Do** offer filter choices with matching imagery and keep saved state coherent.
**Do** keep language destinations coherent with query and image state, and allow German headings to wrap and hyphenate.
**Do** show anonymised plan previews with image-only links and preserve their originals outside the public export.
donts: **Don't** surround project entries with rounded card shells or shadows.
**Don't** turn mood samples into competing brand accents.
**Don't** promote image-derived project palettes into global brand colours or material specifications.
**Don't** add decorative kickers, all-caps section labels or unnecessary numbering.
**Don't** hide information until a scroll animation runs.
**Don't** use a crop that removes the useful room context or stretch an image out of proportion.
**Don't** communicate selection through colour alone or remove keyboard outlines.
**Don't** autoplay films or make their audio part of carousel rotation.
**Don't** upscale small-source studies to simulate high-resolution imagery or activate 360° exploration without a visitor action.
